options.text: Yes. Cooling puts the fold back, like ice re-freezing.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Cool it and it goes back."

options.text: No. The chain unfolded when hot and then tangled with itself and its neighbours. It does not find its old fold again.
Yes, but only if you heat it again to "unlock" it.
